svg.title: Zumo 32U4 OLED — Hardware Diagram
svg.desc: Robot photograph © Pololu Corporation — pololu.com. A branded instructional hardware diagram for the Zumo 32U4 OLED. The authentic Pololu top-view PNG is embedded byte-for-byte without transcoding. Vector callouts identify the OLED display, buttons A, B, and C, the reset button, the power switch, and the Micro-USB port.
svg.text: Top view · front of robot at top

g.text: Shows menus, sensor data, and status.
User pushbutton at the lower edge.
Turns the robot off or on.
